headline: Yanming (Owen) Dong rises to 30th on ARC-2

sections.text: Yanming (Owen) Dong added 9.86 points to reach 61.53, moving from 46th to 30th on the ARC-AGI-2 public board.
The move puts Dong among the board's top 30 as the public standings continue to shift.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-2 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
